alerts.title: Alerts: devices, standby, price tiers, your thresholds
alerts.open: {count, plural, one {# alert} other {# alerts}} to look at

longer_than_usual.title: {device} runs longer than usual
longer_than_usual.body: Over the last {days} days each run lasted about {recent_min} min, against {usual_min} min usually. Check the door seals and the condenser.

standby_high.title: Night-time standby up to {recent_w, number} W
standby_high.body: The last {nights} nights, from midnight to 5 am, the home drew about {recent_w, number} W, against {usual_w, number} W usually. A new always-on device, or one that does not switch off fully.

unexplained_load.title: An unknown load of about {watts, number} W is running
unexplained_load.body: For {minutes} min the part no device explains has been well above its usual ({usual_w, number} W). Check for something left on.

tier_near.title: {days, plural, =0 {This cycle is now in tier {tier_no}} one {Tier {tier_no} in about a day} other {Tier {tier_no} in about # days}}
tier_near.body: From {from_kwh, number} kWh, each kWh costs {price_per_kwh, number} ₫ before VAT.

watch_hit.title: {label} went {op, select, gt {above} other {below}} {threshold, number}{unit, select, vnd { ₫} kwh { kWh} w { W} other {}}
watch_hit.body: At the check: {value, number}{unit, select, vnd { ₫} kwh { kWh} w { W} other {}}. {repeat, select, true {Wappi will tell you again next time if it is still {op, select, gt {over} other {under}} (the next day, cycle or hour).} other {You asked Wappi to tell you when this happened; this alert is now off.}}

watch_broken.title: Could not keep watching: {label}
watch_broken.body: Wappi failed to check this several times in a row and stopped. Ask Wappi to set it again.

device_on.title: {device} turned on at {at}
device_on.body: You asked Wappi to tell you each time it turns on.

device_off.title: {device} turned off (run from {at})
device_off.body: You asked Wappi to tell you each time it turns off.

device_long_run.title: {device} ran over {threshold, number} min
device_long_run.body: This run has lasted {value, number} min.

usage_anomaly.title: Today your home used {excess_kwh, number} kWh more than usual (≈ {excess_vnd, number} ₫)
usage_anomaly.body: Against a day like today (weather, days off, routine), usage since {start} is above what was expected.
usage_anomaly.weather: The weather already raised the usual by {weather_kwh, number} kWh; the excess is beyond that.
